description: Preview or commit one draft-safe proposal from a Signal Center event. The event, not the caller, selects the only allowed action descriptor. First call without previewReceipt/idempotencyKey to validate and receive a bound receipt; repeat the identical call with both values to create the proposal. This never executes the resulting ActionItem or changes signal trust mode. Requires Write scope plus the live actions.prepare capability; client-pinned credentials cannot prepare tenant-scoped ActionItems in this phase.

eventId.description: Signal Center event id returned by list_open_actions.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque event version returned by list_open_actions/get_action_context.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt.

previewReceipt.description: Receipt returned by the preview call; omit on preview.

proposal.description: Exactly one typed proposal branch; the event determines which branch is legal.

backorderEmail.description: Backorder-email draft fields; valid only for a backorder alert.

markdown.description: Markdown proposal fields; valid only for a stale-inventory alert.

purchaseOrder.description: Purchase-order draft fields; valid only for a vendor reorder alert.

transfer.description: Transfer-order draft fields; valid only for a scheduled transfer-reorder alert.

name: prepare_action
title: Prepare Action
